newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus medical conference organisers in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus medical conference organisers in IPO.

text.p: Medical conference organisers Options Eurocongress Ltd will launch an initial public offering of 1.9 million shares this month and list on the Cyprus Stock Exchange, the company said on Tuesday.
The company is the first services-oriented firm to be given a listing on the bourse, which trades in 88 securities of 43 listed companies.
The shares, which will have a nominal value of 25 cents, are to be offered for sale at 50 cents when the issue opens on July 7. It closes on July 21.
Shareholders will also be eligible for one bonus warrant for every five ordinary shares held.
The company, which went public in Cyprus this year, specialises in organising medical conferences wherever a client wants, with about 90 percent of its work overseas.
"Being mobile is a big strength," said Mary O'Doherty, a member of the board and head of the Brussels office of Options Eurocongress.

Options Eurocongress was established in Athens in 1991. It moved to Cyprus a year later and was operating on the island on an offshore basis until 1996, when it changed its status to onshore. It went public this year.

According to company projections turnover is expected to reach 4.8 million pounds ($9.3 million) in 1997, 5.9 million in 1998 and 5.6 million in 1999. Pre-tax profit is forecast at 391,000 pounds for 1997, 435,000 in 1998 and 454,000 in 1999. The company also plans to issue a dividend of 2.5 cents per share in 1997, 3.0 cents in 1998 and 3.75 cents in 1999.
Lead underwriters are Share Link Securities Limited. ($=0.515 pounds)
